bkash.title: bKash (বিকাশ)
bkash.instructions:
1. Open your bKash app or dial *247#
2. Select "Send Money" or "Payment" to 01711-223344
3. Enter exact Order Amount
4. Enter your phone number as reference
5. Complete transaction and submit your 10-digit TrxID below for admin verification.

nagad.title: Nagad (নগদ)
nagad.instructions:
1. Open Nagad app or dial *167#
2. Select "Send Money" to 01811-223344
3. Enter the total amount
4. Confirm PIN & copy the 8-digit Transaction ID to paste below.

rocket.title: Rocket (রকেট)
rocket.instructions:
1. Open Rocket app or dial *322#
2. Select "Send Money" to 01911-223344-9
3. Enter Transaction ID below.

policies.aboutUs:
KH SHOP ZONE was founded with a singular commitment: delivering 100% authentic, premium lifestyle goods directly to homes across Bangladesh. From artisan perfumes and handwoven festive wear to genuine skincare and daily electronics, every single piece in our catalog is verified for authentic origin and superior craftsmanship.

We provide rapid delivery across all 64 districts in Bangladesh with complete transparency, Cash on Delivery convenience, and dedicated customer care.
policies.shippingPolicy:
We partner with Bangladesh's premier courier networks (Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, eCourier) to ensure safe, tracked nationwide delivery.

• Inside Dhaka: Delivered within 24 to 48 hours. Shipping fee: ৳60.
• Outside Dhaka: Delivered within 3 to 5 business days. Shipping fee: ৳120.
• Orders exceeding ৳2,000 enjoy 100% FREE delivery nationwide.

Once dispatched, you will receive an SMS and courier tracking code to monitor delivery live.
policies.returnPolicy:
Your peace of mind is our utmost priority. We offer a hassle-free 7-day return and exchange policy:

1. If an item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, report it within 24 hours of delivery.
2. Products must remain unused, unwashed, and in original packaging with tags attached.
3. Return courier pickup will be arranged, and refund/replacement processed within 3–5 business days.
policies.terms:
By placing an order on KH SHOP ZONE, you confirm all provided details (name, phone number, delivery address) are accurate.

Manual mobile banking transactions (bKash, Nagad, Rocket) require manual verification by our billing desk against bank statements before order dispatch. We never claim manual payments are auto-verified.

Orders can be canceled by the customer anytime prior to dispatch while in 'Pending' status.
policies.privacy:
KH SHOP ZONE respects your personal privacy. Customer contact details, addresses, and transaction references are collected solely to fulfill and ship your orders.

We never sell, rent, or lease customer data to third parties. All internal admin actions are logged for security.
